summary: Frontend-only visual verification of ActivityLog 'Detail Perubahan' expanded panel new multi-column grid layout. Logged in as admin/admin123, opened /arc/activity-log, expanded a many-field row (HR & Payroll UBAH, 41 detail fields) and a simple row (Order UBAH INFO TAMBAHAN, 3 detail fields). Confirmed layout renders as a horizontal responsive grid (4 columns at 1920px wide viewport) flowing left-to-right, with small uppercase gray labels above each <pre> value. Expand/collapse toggling works, no overflow.

issues: Minor: long field labels are truncated with CSS 'truncate' with no tooltip/title attr — e.g. 'insurance_ena…', 'kendaraan_operas…', 'emergency1_relati…'. Users cannot see the full field name. Consider adding title={k} to the label div so hovering reveals the full key.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add title={k} attribute to the truncated label div in ActivityLog.js (line 107) so full field names are visible on hover.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via DOM inspection: grid-template-columns='119.312px 119.312px 119.312px 119.312px' (4-col at xl), items flow horizontally (row 1 lefts=324/467/611/754 then wraps). For a 41-field HR row, values are short enough that none crossed the 40-char/isLong threshold (so no full-width row was produced in that particular sample); the isLong branch was not visually exercised on a JSON/object value. Row idx 20 (Panjar Kerja SETTLE) has awb_breakdown=[...] object which would trigger col-span full-width — worth spot-checking if any regression arises. Expand/collapse toggling verified functional. No console errors beyond expected React Router v7 future-flag warnings.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defect. Layout matches the requested spec: responsive grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 with per-cell uppercase gray label + <pre> value; isLong (object or >40 chars) spans full width.
